View helper enumerating pool addresses over a range.
View helper computing pool age in days from the pool genesis timestamp and block.timestamp.
View helper computing ROI from staked vs current pool amounts.
View helper dividing annualised ROI by pool age.
Pure math helper: amount * part / total.
Pure math helper: (x*X*Y)/(x+X)^2.
Pure math helper computing stake units from base/token reserves and inputs.
Pure math helper computing asymmetric share with square/cube terms.
Caller-controlled address, used as member, balance owner and authorization subject.
Miner-influenceable timestamp, referenced via now in getPoolAge.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == DEPLOYER) guarding privileged execution.
Division by the total parameter in calcShare; unvalidated zero divisor reverts or mis-shares.
Division by (x+X)^2 in calcSwapOutput; zero denominator when reserves are empty.
Chained mul/add/div computations over reserves in calcStakeUnits, sensitive to overflow and zero reserves.
Subtraction part2 - part3 and cube division in calcAsymmetricShare, sensitive to underflow/overflow.
Timestamp arithmetic now.sub(genesis) producing a miner-influenced age value.

edges.reason: The onlyDeployer require branches on msg.sender equality with DEPLOYER.
DEPLOYER state variable feeds the authorization comparison.
The modifier gates execution of the privileged setGenesisDao function.
Constructor writes msg.sender into DEPLOYER, establishing the privileged role.
msg.sender is the value assigned to DEPLOYER during deployment.
Constructor initializes the BASE state variable.
The dao parameter is cast and stored into the DAO state variable.
Only the deployer-authorized path may rewrite the DAO pointer.
DAO.ROUTER() is resolved inside getPoolAge to locate the pool.
DAO.ROUTER() is resolved inside getPoolROI to locate the pool.
DAO.ROUTER().tokenCount() bounds the tokensInRange loop.
DAO.ROUTER().getToken(i) is read inside the poolsInRange loop.
getPoolAPY calls getPoolAge as its divisor.
getPoolAPY calls getPoolROI for the average ROI.
block.timestamp is consumed by the now.sub(genesis) computation.
Miner-influenceable timestamp arithmetic determines the age returned by getPoolAge.
The token parameter drives the pool lookup inside getPoolAge.
The genesis local feeds the timestamp subtraction.
part parameter flows into the calcShare numerator.
amount parameter flows into the calcShare multiplication.
The total parameter is the divisor of the calcShare division.
calcShare performs amount.mul(part).div(total) which reverts or mis-prices on zero total.
x parameter flows into calcSwapOutput.
X parameter flows into calcSwapOutput.
Y parameter flows into calcSwapOutput.
calcSwapOutput performs numerator.div(denominator) with a squared denominator.
The numerator local is the dividend of the swap-output division.
The denominator local is the divisor and can be zero for empty reserves.
b parameter flows into calcStakeUnits.
t parameter flows into calcStakeUnits.
T parameter flows into calcStakeUnits.
B parameter participates in the chained multiply/add/divide of calcStakeUnits.
calcStakeUnits executes numerator.div(4*T*B), which is unsafe when reserves are zero.
u parameter flows into calcAsymmetricShare.
U parameter flows into calcAsymmetricShare.
A parameter flows into calcAsymmetricShare.
calcAsymmetricShare performs part2.sub(part3) and divides by U^3.
The part3 local is the subtrahend whose magnitude can invert the subtraction.
The token parameter selects the asset described by getTokenDetails.
The member parameter determines whose token balance is returned.
getTokenDetails delegates directly to getTokenDetailsWithMember.
getTokenDetails passes msg.sender as the member.
msg.sender is used as the balance owner in getTokenDetailsWithMember.
The caller-supplied token address becomes the target of an external call.
The external token contract can call back into this contract while state is being read.
